_comment: One disposition per census entry point. Keys are entry-point ids from
pipeline/census.report.json. The census fails while any entry point is
unclassified, which is the mechanical 'no unclassified item' check.
disposition must be exactly one of:
preserve - stays as-is and is a legitimate part of the target system
replace  - its behaviour moves into the new pipeline; the old path dies
retire   - deleted outright, with absence asserted after cutover
owner is the repository or person accountable for carrying it out.
note records why, so the judgement survives the person who made it.
Filling this in is a deliberate act per entry point. Do not bulk-assign:
the value of this file is that someone looked at each one. A 'retire'
entry becomes a stale-disposition id once the path is gone, and that is
the proof of retirement rather than an assumption of it.
